notebook: PLAN: Spend the final solve on the only independently validated benign cost reduction, then finish with the best valid design. Keep the 0.539 core and ethane stripper at boil-up 0.5; reduce only T from 50 to 40 stages. R852 showed 40 stages preserved the C4/C5 split and saved about $0.6M/yr, while root reduction to 45 hurt C5 recovery. No further heavy recovery or heat integration: both proved uneconomic.
